checks.detail: Each integer 0 through 100 once, in order

limits: Technical QA; final visual/content review remains separate.
101 indexed tile fills are checked; digit glyphs and prose are not OCR-verified.
Unchanged video is sampled; audio comparisons cover both complete preserved ranges.
Audio presence/correlation is not speech transcription or a narration-content certificate.
The exact mathematical certificate is accepted separately; animation is not an RH proof.
tileScope: 101 position-indexed classification fills; native number labels require visual review.

visualReview.scope: Independent visual inspection of seven decoded stills from three native clips; phase motion direction is checked at five sampled positions. No audio, uninterrupted playback, every-frame, or assembled 320-second video review is claimed. Mathematical conclusions remain those of the separately hash-bound core and content reviews.
